name: Trujillo

queries.query: Trujillo Peru official municipal cadastral geovisor lot parcels GIS PLANDET
queries.result: Official municipal geoviewer has a public shell and cadastral-lot tables. The client fetches table-backed GeoJSON with optional bbox but no field projection, so no feature request was made without a safe schema.

queries.query: Trujillo Perú catastro urbano geovisor lotes portal municipalidad provincial
queries.result: La Municipalidad Provincial identifica a PLANDET como responsable del catastro distrital y del Geovisor Cartográfico con información de lotes. El cliente obtiene GeoJSON desde una tabla y permite bbox, pero no incluye selección de campos; no se consultaron entidades ni se retuvo geometría.

portals.observation: Municipal organizational regulation assigns the PLANDET Geomatics and Cadastre subunit to maintain Trujillo’s cadastral information system, maintain the city geoviewer, and issue cadastral-code certificates for Trujillo district.
First-party municipal announcement says the public Geovisor Cartográfico includes lot information, zoning and other geographic layers for the Trujillo metropolitan/provincial area.
Current PLANDET page identifies the municipal unit responsible for district cadastre, property formalization and territorial planning; it links the public viewer.
Public map shell publishes table names including `s25_lote_cata`, `s26_lote_cata`, `s27_lote_cata`, `s32_lote_cata`, `s33_lote_cata`, and `sector13_lote_catastral`.
Viewer client fetches `api.php?tabla={name}` and appends a bounding-box parameter when supplied. It provides no field-selection parameter; no feature request or geometry was made.
Municipal performance document reports urban cadastral updates and maintenance of the PLANDET geoviewer; it does not define a safe feature schema.

verifiedParcelResponse.limitations: No parcel feature response or full polygon was retrieved.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: The Municipalidad Provincial de Trujillo’s PLANDET unit is responsible for maintaining the Trujillo cadastral information system and public cartographic geoviewer; the first-party viewer lists cadastral-lot tables. This verifies a city-local cadastre and map service, but the public feature schema and data properties are not constrained by the client.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: The official public viewer exposes a table-backed GeoJSON route without a field-selection parameter. Its property schema is not published, so a bounded query might return unreviewed fields. No feature request or geometry was made.
